name: AI Customer Inquiry - Google Form Automation copy

parameters.text:
=
You are an AI Customer Support Classification and Response Assistant.

Customer Details:
Name: {{ $('If row does not exist').item.json.customer_name }}
Email: {{ $('If row does not exist').item.json.email }}
Selected Inquiry Type: {{ $('If row does not exist').item.json.inquiry_type }}
Message: {{ $('If row does not exist').item.json.message }}
Inquiry ID: {{ $('If row does not exist').item.json.inquiry_id }}

TASKS:
1. Classify the inquiry into ORDER, DELIVERY, RETURN, COMPLAINT, or GENERAL.
2. Assign priority HIGH, MEDIUM, or LOW.
3. Summarize the issue in one sentence.
4. Draft a professional, friendly customer response.

PRIORITY RULES:
HIGH: Urgent complaints, repeated unresolved issues, serious service failures.
MEDIUM: Returns, exchanges, standard requests requiring employee action.
LOW: General information requests.

IMPORTANT BUSINESS RULES:
- Do not invent company policies.
- Do not promise refunds, exchanges, delivery dates, or prepaid return labels.
- Do not claim an issue has already been escalated.
- Do not claim an employee has taken action.
- If policy details are unknown, say the support team will review the request.
- All responses are drafts requiring human approval.
- Do not include unverified company names or commitments.
- Personalize the response using the customer's name.
- Keep the response concise, clear, and professional.

Return ONLY valid JSON:

{
  "category": "RETURN",
  "priority": "MEDIUM",
  "summary": "Customer requests a size exchange.",
  "suggested_reply": "Dear Customer, thank you for contacting us. Our support team will review your exchange request and provide guidance on the available options."
}

parameters.subject: =Customer Inquiry - {{ $json.priority }} - {{ $json.inquiry_id }}
parameters.message:
= {{ (() => { const d = $json; const escapeHtml = (value) => String(value ?? '') .replace(/&/g, '&') .replace(//g, '>') .replace(/"/g, '"') .replace(/'/g, '''); const safe = (value) => escapeHtml(value).replace(/\r?\n/g, '
'); const priority = String(d.priority ?? '').toUpperCase(); if (!['HIGH', 'MEDIUM', 'LOW'].includes(priority)) { throw new Error('Missing or invalid inquiry priority'); } const requiredFields = [ 'inquiry_id', 'customer_name', 'email', 'message', 'category', 'summary', 'status' ]; for (const field of requiredFields) { if (!String(d[field] ?? '').trim()) { throw new Error(`Missing email field: ${field}`); } } const priorityColor = priority === 'HIGH' ? '#B42318' : priority === 'MEDIUM' ? '#B54708' : '#027A48'; const title = priority === 'HIGH' ? 'Urgent Customer Inquiry' : priority === 'MEDIUM' ? 'Customer Inquiry - Review Required' : 'General Customer Inquiry'; const actionText = priority === 'HIGH' ? 'URGENT: Review and prioritize this inquiry. Verify the customer details and approve or edit the AI-generated response before contacting the customer.' : priority === 'MEDIUM' ? 'Review this inquiry, verify the details, and approve or edit the AI-generated response before contacting the customer.' : 'Review this general inquiry and approve or edit the suggested response before contacting the customer.'; return `
CUSTOMER SUPPORT AUTOMATION

${title}

${safe(priority)} PRIORITY

Inquiry Reference

${safe(d.inquiry_id)}

Customer Name ${safe(d.customer_name)}
Inquiry Type ${safe(d.inquiry_type)}
Category ${safe(d.category)}
Priority ${safe(priority)}
Customer Email ${safe(d.email)}
Status ${safe(d.status)}

Customer Message

${safe(d.message)}

AI Analysis

${safe(d.summary)}

AI Suggested Response

${safe(d.suggested_reply || 'Manual response required.')}
ACTION REQUIRED

${actionText}

Generated by n8n + Groq AI
Internal support notification — not sent to the customer
`; })() }}
